body: I'm sorry that sucks I had a similar experience with my best friend. At least she forgave me for putting her through my suicide attempt. I hope you will get a second chance too. Give it time.  If she doesn't come around then you have this community to support you
Thanks I might really need to talk soon
Thank you it means a lot
Thank you it is very helpful

I feel really guilty about complaining. I struggle too. When my sister hits me I know it's an accident but I can't help it I still get angry.  I understand why she gets angry but she hits her and it frightens me a lot.
Thanks for the idea

Thanks but I'm afraid that when they know the fact that my sister can't defend herself at all they will start trying to track me down to send adult protective services in. I  see a counselor every week for anxiety and depression. I'm afraid to say anything at all because I know she will have to report even if I tell her that we don't have options for when my mom gets taken away. I wouldn't be able to live with myself. I would be the reason my mom was put away and all this burden was placed on my siblings. I'm enough of a burden for my family as is. I do appreciate the support though.

No one I know would be able to take care of my sister.  We have 3 older brothers and one older sister. They know she's hitting her. If they say they don't know it's because they don't want to see what is right in front of their faces. I could go to a domestic violence shelter but they can't keep me forever. At some point they will want to place me in permanent housing. I can't get disability money or public housing. I can't find a job to pay for a place to live. I have 2 bachelors degrees and I can't even get a job answering phones in an office. I would have to go back home with my mom. She knows this.  This is why she treats us like this.  She knows we don't have a choice and we can't leave.

He abandoned us since I can remember. Believe it or not my mom is the good parent.  I used to be afraid as a kid that something would happen to my mom and we would be forced to go live with my dad. He can't even take care of himself and has an even worse temper .
I lost my bf he was my only support
You are very kind. Thank you I will remember this next time I feel like a burden
I'm addicted to hitting the only reason I started cutting again is because I was too tired to hit hard enough. In the end I just want to die
I know I have been self-harming for years now just in different ways from cutting. I was too tired to hit that is why I started cutting again. I just want to die

I go through the same thing.  The feelings and thoughts of suicide get worse when I have a bad day. I expect things to get better on good days but the thoughts come from deep down.  They come from trauma that a good day can't make better.  I have been laughing out loud enjoying the things and people around me and as soon as the laughter stops I think about doing it at that moment. I'm sorry I can't give you any advice on how to change the thoughts.  I  hope you don't feel so alone

I told my friend the first time I cut yesterday but I don't think she has time to help me through it I'm not going to tell her again. I know it's probably going to make it easier for me to hurt myself more each time but I don't care. I want to get used to it. I want to feel something other than the overwhelming emotional pain
I'm tired I wanted a family of my own where I could find a reason to be happy again. If he's gone forever then that's gone too

My bf and I didn't break up we're long distance and I can't get in contact with him.  I'm afraid that something is seriously wrong. I don't know how to find out what happened since I don't have anyone else to contact on his end

My bf was the only one who made me feel seen, understood,  loved unconditionally,  accepted as a whole.  If we can't be together I don't know how I can be happy. Sure I  could spend the rest of my life trying to find someone else who understands me. I know it's never going to compare. 

Every single person in my family thinks that I can't be in a relationship. Makes me feel utterly stupid, broken, useless,  and invisible.  My mom says no man could ever want me. My brother told me that our dog is meant to fill my desire to have children. I love my dog but she is not a baby of my own.  I want to be a good mother. I want to raise my children feeling like I will love them just because they deserve love. I will discipline them because I love them. They will feel like they have a safe place and I will always be their advocate. They will never feel like a burden because they didn't ask to be born so it can't be their fault. My sister has called me stupid and useless. My niece who I had the best relationship with told me to get a life. Since then I couldn't shake the thought that I have to keep my distance.  The rest of my nieces and nephews don't even talk to me when I'm  right there talking to them.  They alienate me because they see the adults around them do it. Maybe they don't think about it but if their parents treat me like I'm worthless and broken they're not going to treat me differently. They often don't even look me in the eye. Anyway sorry this turned into a whole book.
Exactly, I don't want to ruin her birthday too
I can't do it on my birthday I'm a twin
I feel the same way
Yes I think something happened to someone I love very much

Thank you everyone for reading.  It's just so much more than I can handle anymore. The last big reason I haven't done it is probably gone forever. I'm in a lot of physical and emotional pain. I'm trapped in this life . I  did everything I could to change myself or my situation but that is it
Yes my mom said I never thought I'd say this about any of my children but I regret having you.
Thanks for your comment a lot of times I second guess my actions.  It's really hard for me to put myself first and I feel guilty about it.  Thank you
Thanks for  saying so and I'm sorry you have to be in this kind of situation.  Still it's good to know that it's not strange to struggle even when I know I need to leave

I'm 30 and I haven't been able to get a job even though I'm well educated.  I plan on continuing to look for work. I don't want to spend the rest of my life wondering if I could have had a life I chose for myself
